name: texting-suspense
label: Texting / receipts suspense (doc-promo grammar)
description: From ref MUSK doc reel (Instagram, 93.6K likes, measured 2026-10-25): a talking-head/interview spine at ~6 s average shots, cut to full-black iMessage-style chat recreations (recipe.chats) when someone quotes what was said. Bubbles pop in one by one with a typing indicator, the stack scrolls up, and the line the story turns on is shown alone and large. A persistent small title top-left, low warm interview grade, tension bed with a hit every 1-3 s, no captions over the chat cards. Default since 2026-10-29: the chat bubbles sit over the same shot, dimmed and blurred (chats[].layout 'overlay'); the full-black card is a variation (layout 'card').
